coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: Mission Walk (330 Berry St)
record.summary: Mission Walk is a below-market-rate condominium development at 330 and 335 Berry St: SocketSite (Oct 27, 2008) reported applications for its 131 BMR condos across both addresses, for buyers earning up to 80-100% of area median income, with applications due January 22, 2009 and a lottery scheduled for January 28, 2009; this building (330 Berry St) was completed in 2009 per DataSF Assessor records.

notes.accuracy_caveat: REAL -- surveyed DataSF Building Footprints outline (mblr SF8704278), cross-referenced by position against an OpenStreetMap building/address point (way 56656119) for the name and street address, but trimmed against the adjacent, already-committed Arterra footprint to remove a 712 sq m overlap. The trimmed shape may understate this building's true footprint along the shared edge with Arterra; not a hand trace or plan estimate otherwise. Updated 2026-09-20: extended north by a piece of leftover open ground between mapped shapes, sized to this building's own footprint width and cut by hand by Pier & Point -- not independently sourced or verified against a building footprint of its own.
notes.digitized_from: DataSF Building Footprints (mblr SF8704278) for the building portion only (about 970 sq m of the ~2,863 sq m polygon, after trimming the Arterra overlap); the remaining ~1,893 sq m is a northward extension over leftover open ground, cut by hand on 2026-09-20, which no footprint or OSM outline supports (how it was traced is logged in this shape's data file in the public data repository, https://github.com/pierandpoint/record); name/address from OpenStreetMap way 56656119 (330 Berry St)

milestones.text: Below-market-rate purchase applications open for the 131 condo units at 330/335 Berry St ahead of a January 2009 lottery, while the buildings are still under construction

open_questions: Precise completion month in 2009 is not sourced beyond the bare Assessor year.

DataSF Assessor's own use_code/unit-count fields for this specific parcel (Single Family Residential, 0 units, 2 stories) look like a condo common-element or garage lot rather than the full building, while listing sites describe a larger residential building at this address; not reconciled here.
Unit count for this address alone (as distinct from the combined 131-unit BMR program across both 330 and 335 Berry St) is not confirmed from a single source.
Developer/architect not confirmed from any source checked as of 2026-09-29.

Whether the 131 BMR units were actually allocated by the scheduled January 28, 2009 lottery, and which program they were sold under, are not stated by any source checked: SocketSite's post announces the lottery and names neither the program nor the Redevelopment Agency.
